title: Adding Object Types for ServiceNow Tenants

blocks.text: ServiceNow has many object types available, so the Zscaler service provides a default list of the most commonly used object types. You can add additional object types if they're not on the list.
To add object types for ServiceNow tenants:

blocks.item: In the Zscaler Admin Console, from the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > SaaS Application Tenants.
Click the Edit icon for the ServiceNow tenant that you want to add object types for.

blocks.text: The Edit SaaS Application Tenant page appears.

blocks.item: On the Edit SaaS Application Tenant page:
Default Object Types: View the default list of ServiceNow object types that you can scan with the Data at Rest Scanning Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy.
More Object Types: Enter the object types and click Add Items to include them for scanning.

blocks.text: For the additional object types that are included, the policy scans only the fields specific to description, short_description, and close_notes.

blocks.item: Click Save and activate the change.
